analysis: Buffalo was already a comfortable Elo favorite here, and a confirmed 6-man Chargers inactive list this morning -- starting RT Trey Pipkins III, DL anchor Dalvin Tomlinson, CB Elijah Molden, G Kayode Awosika, TE Charlie Kolar and WR Brenen Thompson -- widens the gap further. The model now projects Buffalo by 13.6 points against a market number of -7, with 68% of simulations having the Bills cover.

The number itself (a full 7) is one of the least attractive lay-numbers in football purely on key-number math, and public money is already heavily on Buffalo (81% of tickets, 73% of handle), so this isnt a hidden angle -- its a real model edge on a popular, well-known side. Size it accordingly rather than treating it as a lock.
